units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 5:22">Targ. Lev. V, 22</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 5:24">24</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 5:2">Targ. Jer. V, 2</cite>; a. fr.—
Shebu. 29ᵃ ודילמא … וכי קא מִשְׁתַּבַּע אדעתא דיריה א׳ perhaps that man saw a huge bird and called it gamla (camel), and when he swore (that he saw a camel fly in the air), he swore in his sense.

<cite ref="Shevuot 29a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>דכי קא משתבע … קא משתבע</he> so that when he swears (that he has paid the money), he swears to the truth in his sense (having given him tokens, v. <cite ref="A01499"><he>אִיסְקוּנְדְּרֵי</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Shevuot 32b:3">Ib. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>אי … הוה מִשְׁתַּבַּעְנָא וכ׳</he> if thou hadst come and testified for me, I should have been assigned an oath and received my claim; <he>מי יימר דמִשְׁתַּבְּעַת</he> who can say that thou wouldst have made oath? <cite ref="Shevuot 32b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>לִישְׁתַּבַּע</he> shall he be admitted to an oath? Ib. 26ᵃ <he>ואנא בשיקרא אִישְׁתַּבְּעִי</he> and have I sworn falsely?; a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 13:19">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XIII, 19</cite> [read:] <he>מִשְׁבָּע אַשְׁבַּע</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:7">Targ. Cant. II, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:4">Targ. Cant. II, 4</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shevuot 36a:6">Shebu. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>אַשְׁבְּעִינְהוּ ולייטינהו</he> he made them swear, and also pronounced a curse upon them.
<cite ref="Shevuot 41a:11">Ib. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מַשְׁבְּעִינָן ליה</he> we do not put him to an oath; a. fr.
